## Description

Change equity exposure or take contrarian/defensive positions when VIX reaches defined historical percentiles.

## Where it may fit

Periods when implied volatility reflects a useful risk regime signal; often paired with broader trend/risk controls.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, volatility overlays, tactical allocation funds.

## Required data

VIX history, equity returns, percentiles, curve data if derivatives used, costs and explicit risk limits.

## Caveats

VIX is a risk-neutral implied-volatility measure, not a direct forecast of market direction.
